items.title: Shared Services Manager
items.snippet: We are looking for a Shared Services Manager to join our People Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets. About Us M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers and has extended $2 billion+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. 86% of customers report an improved quality of life, 55% access formal financial services for the first time, and 70% use our products to earn income. It takes 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents to make that happen. The Role Reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services, you lead day-to-day service delivery: queue health, SLAs, escalations, quality and business continuity, with functional leadership and coaching for colleagues. You also own UK HR operations, from onboarding and right-to-work to payroll and benefits cover, offboarding and contractors. You partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT and external partners including the Home Office, our payroll provider, Papaya, brokers, insurers and NEST. Success means healthy queues, SLAs met and 100% audit-ready right-to-work records. This is a remote role, you would be working with a diverse group of other employees working remotely from locations such as UK, Europe and Africa. You will be reporting to the Head of HR Shared Services. Why this timing matters We are not hiring at random. Reaching 10 by 10 means building the people infrastructure behind our growth. A UK team that delivers onboarding, immigration, payroll and benefits to audit-ready standards is part of that foundation, and you would help set it. What makes this different Your current role: one process, one market. This role: leading HR Shared Services across global and market client groups, while owning UK HR operations and compliance. Every case you close helps someone who is helping deliver financial inclusion. What You'll Do Lead HR Shared Services delivery in Freshservice, managing case allocation, prioritisation, SLAs, ageing items and escalations, and coordinating capacity during peaks and absences. Own UK right-to-work checks and immigration records through the Home Office portal, including annual audits, pre-expiry follow-up, Certificates of Sponsorship and sponsor reporting. Run UK onboarding from accepted offer to first-day readiness, creating accurate HiBob profiles with Talent Acquisition, IT and hiring managers. Manage employee lifecycle transactions, contracts, probation, letters and audit-ready HR records, reconciling data across HiBob, Freshservice and payroll files. Act as UK backup for payroll, Group Benefits, NEST pensions, Global Mobility and employee relations, supporting inputs, provider deadlines and compliant case documentation. Coordinate offboarding for UK employees, EOR workers and contractors, and maintain the UK Contractor List as the source of truth. Produce regular reports, close audit findings, maintain SOPs and the knowledge base, and improve processes while protecting data under UK GDPR. What You'll Need A Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Relations or a related field. CIPD qualification or progress toward it is desirable. Proven experience managing end-to-end HR Shared Services across multiple processes, stakeholders and client groups, including queues, SLAs, escalations, controls and continuous improvement. Practical UK experience in right-to-work checks, immigration records, sponsorship administration and Home Office processes. Experience coordinating UK payroll inputs, benefits, pensions, contracts, onboarding, lifecycle changes and offboarding with external providers. Experience with HRIS and service-management platforms. HiBob and Freshservice are preferred. Strong attention to detail, stakeholder management, sound judgement and high standards of confidentiality. Experience working across countries or markets is strongly preferred. The reality check This role is demanding. You will run a global service queue and a UK compliance portfolio at the same time, with competing priorities, high-volume requests and confidential cases arriving together. Right-to-work and sponsorship deadlines don’t move, and as payroll backup your accuracy shows up in someone’s payslip. When colleagues are away, you are the cover for payroll, benefits, mobility and employee relations. If you are already the person who tracks every expiry date and closes every loop, you’re probably ready for exactly this. Why M-KOPA? At M-KOPA, we empower our people to own their careers through diverse development programs, coaching partnerships, and on-the-job training. We support individual journeys with family-friendly policies, prioritize well-being, and embrace flexibility. Join us in shaping the future of M-KOPA as we grow together. Explore more at m-kopa.com . Recognized four times by the Financial Times as one Africa's fastest growing companies (2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026), named on CNBC's World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025 & 2026 and by TIME100 Most influential companies in the world 2023 and 2024 , we've served over 10 million customers, unlocking $2 billion in cumulative credit for the everyday earners across Africa, in addition to over 10,000 e-bikes financed in Kenya. Important Notice M-KOPA is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer committed to assembling a diverse, broadly trained staff. Women, minorities, and people with disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply. M-KOPA explicitly prohibits the use of Forced or Child Labour and respects the rights of its employees to agree to terms and conditions of employment voluntarily, without coercion, and freely terminate their employment on appropriate notice. M-KOPA shall ensure that its Employees are of legal working age and shall comply with local laws for youth employment or student work, such as internships or apprenticeships. M-KOPA does not collect/charge any money as a pre-employment or post-employment requirement. This means that we never ask for ‘recruitment fees’, ‘processing fees’, ‘interview fees’, or any other kind of money in exchange for offer letters or interviews at any time during the hiring process. Applications for this position will be reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisting and interviews will take place at any stage during the recruitment process. We reserve the right to close the vacancy early if a suitable candidate is selected before the advertised closing date. If your application is successful M-KOPA undertakes pre-employment background checks as part of its recruitment process, these include; criminal records, identification verification, academic qualifications, employment dates and employer references. items.title: Stage - Service client : Onboarding
items.snippet: Notre département “Care” (ou service client) est composé de 3 équipes : La team Customer Care Representative, qui répond à toutes les questions ponctuelles sur des sujets variés comme le droit, la comptabilité, les travaux, l’utilisation de la plateforme, etc. La team Customer Success, qui accompagne sur le long terme les copropriétés sur le modèle coopératif et les aide dans leurs problématiques complexes, La team Customer Onboarding (10 personnes) : qui organise la phase de transition, paramètre l’espace client, gère la reprise comptable, et guide le client dans sa nouvelle fonction de syndic. C’est cette équipe que tu rejoins. Ce département est central chez Matera, et nécessite de bien communiquer et de se synchroniser avec les équipes Commerciale, et les équipes d’experts Juristes, Travaux, Comptables etc., afin de garantir une satisfaction client optimale ! En tant que " Customer Onboarding ", ton rôle est d’accompagner les clients dans leur projet de changement de syndic, dans leur prise en main de l’outil Matera, et d'améliorer leur expérience et leur satisfaction dès leurs premiers mois avec nous. Tu reprends en main la relation client dès leur signature de contrat avec l’équipe Commerciale. Concrètement, tes missions sont les suivantes : Accompagner la configuration & la relation client : ◦ Aider les nouveaux clients à configurer leur espace sur la plateforme et les guider dans la prise en main de l'outil. ◦ Assister l'équipe dans le suivi des dossiers administratifs (relances, prise de rendez-vous). ◦ Présenter les services complémentaires Matera (compte de paiement) lors des échanges d'onboarding. Découvrir la comptabilité de copropriété : ◦ Se former aux bases de la comptabilité immobilière auprès de l'équipe Accounting. ◦ Participer aux opérations de saisie et de paramétrage : vérification des tantièmes, création de comptes, contrôle des documents comptables et rapprochements bancaires simples. Contribuer à la numérisation & la vie de l'équipe : ◦ Participer à la numérisation et à la structuration des archives documentaires des copropriétés. ◦ Assurer la bonne transmission des dossiers entre les commerciaux, l'Onboarding et le Customer Success . ◦ Proposer tes idées pour améliorer les méthodes de travail de l'équipe. Ton parcours d'intégration & d'apprentissage • Deux semaines d'immersion : Découverte globale de l'entreprise, de notre produit et de nos différents métiers. • Formations dédiées : Un accompagnement progressif sur le fonctionnement du syndic, la comptabilité et l'utilisation de la plateforme Matera. • Ce que ce stage va t'apporter : Tu développeras des compétences transversales solides en relation client, en comptabilité immobilière et en gestion de projet digital. Les avantages Les plus : Rémunération : 1000€ (stage de Césure) - 1200€ (stage de fin d’études de master) 2 semaines d’onboarding pour te faire découvrir le monde de la copropriété et le fonctionnement de Matera Un suivi hebdomadaire par ton/ta Manager Gymlib pour faire du sport à petits prix Des bons plans culture avec la plateforme Leeto La base légale : Une demi-journée de congé par mois (cumulable) Carte Swile - pris en charge à 50% Prise en charge des transports à 50% Un ordinateur et équipements te seront fournis Les informations pratiques : Localisation : Paris 10 Occasionnel sous validation du manager Type de contrat : stage de 6 mois - démarrage 4 janvier 2027 Déroulement des entretiens : 1️⃣ Premier entretien téléphonique de 20 à 30 min. avec notre recruteuse 2️⃣ Rencontre avec ton ou ta manager, et un membre de ta future équipe (30mn en visio) 3️⃣ Offre À savoir : 🕑 Nous nous efforçons de faire un retour sur ta candidature le plus rapidement possible (sous une semaine). Que le retour soit positif ou négatif, tu recevras un mail de notre part - pense à regarder tes spams au cas où. ☝️ Sache que chez Matera, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances et la diversité, c'est pourquoi tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap, seules les compétences et la motivation font la différence ! 🙋‍♂️ Si tu as besoin de prédispositions particulières pour réaliser les entretiens dans les meilleures conditions, tu peux le notifier lors de ta candidature et en informer l’équipe Recrutement. Profil recherché Pour postuler, pas besoin d'être incollable sur les sujets immobiliers ou en syndic de copro, nous avons un parcours d'intégration qui t'apprendra les bases. Idéalement : Tu recherches un stage de 6 mois conventionné, Tu as un bon relationnel, tu es à l’écoute et tu te sens à l’aise au téléphone, Tu es rigoureux·se et irréprochable sur l’orthographe, Tu aimes trouver des solutions pour tes clients et tu es proactif·ve, Tu sais faire preuve d’autonomie, prendre des initiatives, Tu es à l'aise avec la tech. items.title: IT Internship - AI Engineer (IP-Networks Routing)
items.snippet: IT Internship - AI assisted lab operations (AI, API, Scripting, Routing/Switching) Becoming an IT professional that you aspire to be About the Internship Swisscom is always keen on attracting and developing the best talents. As part of the leading telecom and tech company in Switzerland, you will work on real projects that have real impact. From day one, you will be part of an international team collaborating across Switzerland, Rotterdam, and Riga, contributing to innovative solutions in Swisscom’s digital transformation. This means working hands‑on in backend, cloud, or full‑stack development, applying your Computer Science skills to real technical challenges. With colleagues from over 60 nationalities, diversity is not just something we value, it is how we work. We believe in open collaboration, ownership, and continuous learning. You will be encouraged to share ideas, take initiative, and grow within the environment. We respect each other, help each other out, and are not afraid to make mistakes. We make sure you can be the best version of yourself. Our internship program starts on 1st February 2027 . In this 6 months internship you will work in agile teams using Scrum and SAFe, gaining hands-on experience in a fast-paced and supportive environment. About the Internship Project: AI assisted lab operations (AI, API, Scripting, Routing/Switching) This internship project investigates how AI tools, APIs, and automation scripting can accelerate the deployment, maintenance, and documentation of networking laboratory environments. The project will explore AI-assisted configuration generation, automated infrastructure management through APIs, and scripting solutions for routing and switching environments. The objective is to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance documentation quality in modern IT labs. Must-haves: IP-Networks Routing/Switching, Python, APIs Nice-to-haves: UX/UI Who are you? You are a student enrolled in the last year of your HBO or University program in the field of Computer Science, Informatica, or any other similar field. You live in the Netherlands. You are willing to contribute to an international team and you have an agile mindset. You are curious and responsible. You have a good level of English; any other language is a plus. Please note that for non-EU students, it is necessary to provide the NUFFIC Agreement for the 6-month internship from your university in order to be eligible. Perks 810 € gross Monthly Allowance (Full time) IT Equipment Agile working environment and lean management instructor Flexible working time model Plenty of opportunities for training and personal development International Environment Holidays & time off Contact Do you have any questions or do you want to know why we love working at Swisscom? items.snippet: Über Simplyright Simplyright hilft Menschen, die Ärger mit Abos, Kündigungen oder Inkasso-Schreiben haben. Viele Kundinnen und Kunden nutzen dafür unseren Service und unser Abo Simplyright+. Wenn dabei einmal etwas schiefläuft, soll sich sofort ein Mensch persönlich darum kümmern. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Deine Aufgaben Du kümmerst dich ausschließlich um unzufriedene Kundinnen und Kunden. Das ist deine einzige Aufgabe. Du rufst Kunden mit einer Beschwerde schnell zurück, hörst zu und verstehst, was wirklich passiert ist. Du bringst Ruhe in angespannte Gespräche und findest gemeinsam mit dem Kunden eine faire Lösung. Du klärst offene Fragen intern mit unserem Team, zum Beispiel zu Abo, Kündigung, Rückerstattung oder Inkasso-Schreiben, und meldest dich verlässlich beim Kunden zurück. Du dokumentierst jeden Fall sauber in unserem Ticketsystem (Zendesk) und antwortest auch per E-Mail. Dein Ziel: Aus einem verärgerten Kunden wird ein zufriedener Kunde. Das bringst du mit Viel Einfühlungsvermögen und Geduld. Du bleibst ruhig, auch wenn es am Telefon mal laut wird. Gutes Deutsch für Telefongespräche. Ein Akzent ist überhaupt kein Problem, perfektes Deutsch brauchst du nicht. Du bist zuverlässig, denkst mit und hältst, was du versprichst. Idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement oder Callcenter. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Gespür sind ebenfalls willkommen. Ein ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Internet, PC oder Laptop und ein Headset. Wichtig – Arbeitsmittel: Ein Windows-Laptop oder Windows-PC sowie ein Headset werden nicht vom Arbeitgeber gestellt. Du bringst beides selbst mit und nutzt es für deine Arbeit. Das bieten wir 2.500 € Gehalt pro Monat. Arbeitszeiten: Montag - Freitag von 08:30 - 17:00 Uhr. 100 % Remote: Du arbeitest von überall auf der Welt. Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, Start ab sofort. Eine gründliche Einarbeitung in unsere Produkte und Abläufe. Kurze Wege ins Team und direkt zur Geschäftsführung. Eine Aufgabe mit Sinn: Du hilfst Menschen, die gerade gestresst sind. items.title: Venture Develoment Intern (d/f/m)
items.snippet: Our story: Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence. Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016. The opportunity At Taxfix, we have made tax filing simpler for millions of people. Now, we are looking to build our next major growth engine. We are looking for an entrepreneurial Venture Development Intern to join the Office of the COO . You will work directly with our Chief Operating Officer to explore, validate and build a new product proposition from the ground up. Think of this as a founder’s associate role for an internal startup: you will turn an ambiguous opportunity into actionable hypotheses, run experiments and help build the business case for launch. At Taxfix, AI is part of how we work and build—not just something we talk about. You will use AI tools hands-on to move faster from idea to evidence and from evidence to action. Duration: Fixed-term, full-time internship for a minimum of 3 months and up to 6 months. What you will do Discover and validate: Research markets and competitors, speak with potential customers and design experiments to test customer needs, demand and key assumptions. Build the business case: Develop pricing and unit-economics models, assess commercial viability and map the operational requirements for launch and scale. Turn ideas into tangible experiments: Use AI-native and no-code tools to create early prototypes, landing pages or other practical tests. Learn from the results and iterate with the COO and relevant teams. Shape the go-to-market plan: Explore positioning, distribution, regulatory considerations and how to build on Taxfix’s brand and capabilities. Communicate for decisions: Combine research, data and insights into clear recommendations, concise memos and presentations for the COO, Leadership Team and Board. Work AI-first and responsibly: Use approved AI tools to support research, analysis, prototyping and everyday workflows. Check outputs and sources critically, protect sensitive information and involve the right colleagues when needed. Academic collaboration If you are completing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, we encourage you to explore combining the internship with your thesis. Your work could inform real strategic decisions, with access to C-level perspectives and relevant company insights, subject to confidentiality and data-protection requirements. Who you are Entrepreneurial and hands-on: You are excited by building something from zero to one, comfortable with ambiguity and ready to take ownership rather than wait for a playbook. AI-native builder mindset: You are familiar with generative AI tools and use them—or are keen to use them—to research, analyze, prototype and automate. You enjoy turning ideas into tangible outputs; you do not need to be a software engineer. Critical thinker: You know that AI can accelerate your work but does not replace judgment. You question assumptions, verify outputs and can explain your reasoning. Structured and analytical: You can break down a broad question into hypotheses and practical workstreams. You are comfortable using Excel for analysis and modelling and PowerPoint to communicate a clear story. Curious and commercially minded: You enjoy understanding customers and connecting their needs to pricing, economics and a viable business model. Strong communicator: You can share ideas clearly and confidently with colleagues and senior stakeholders in German and English. Eager to learn: You are pursuing or have recently pursued a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in business or a related field, and are motivated to learn quickly in a fast-moving environment. What we offer C-level mentorship: Work closely with the COO and gain first-hand exposure to executive decision-making. Real ownership: Contribute to building a new proposition, not just supporting a predefined process. Accelerated learning: Gain experience across strategy, product, commercial, operations and venture building. A strong network: Collaborate with Taxfix leaders and connect with our network of founders and investors. An international environment: Join a dynamic team in Berlin with a flexible hybrid setup. If you are excited to combine structured thinking, AI tools and a founder’s mindset to help build what comes next at Taxfix, we would love to hear from you. Why Taxfix? A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals. Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible. Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions. Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office. Excited? So are we. Check out our Life at Taxfix page on LinkedIn to get a glimpse of our culture. At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. items.title: Founder's Associate Intern
items.snippet: Als Founders Associate Intern arbeitest du direkt an der Seite des Founding Teams und bist in die wichtigsten strategischen und operativen Themen eingebunden. Du entwickelst neue Ideen und Geschäftsansätze mit und bringst sie hands-on in die Umsetzung. Dabei übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung, treibst eigene Projekte voran und sorgst dafür, dass aus Ideen konkrete Ergebnisse werden. Neben Business Development und Business Operations bist du auch im Daily Business eng eingebunden und koordinierst wichtige Schnittstellen zu Investoren, Banken und weiteren Stakeholdern. Wir suchen bewusst keine klassische Praktikantin bzw. keinen klassischen Praktikanten, sondern jemanden mit Entrepreneurial Mindset und echtem Drive, der Lust hat, ein Unternehmen von Anfang an mit aufzubauen. Die Rolle ist dabei mehr als ein Praktikum: Unser Ziel ist es, die Person im Anschluss idealerweise als ersten Full-Time Hire langfristig ins Team zu holen. Worum es geht Die Energiewende braucht Kapital. Gleichzeitig wächst in Deutschland der Markt für Erneuerbare-Energie-Projekte – doch die passende Finanzierung kommt noch viel zu selten effizient zustande. Was bislang fehlt, ist ein Tech-Layer, der Investoren, Projektentwickler und Banken intelligent miteinander verbindet. Wir glauben, dass darin enormes Potenzial steckt. Deshalb arbeiten wir aktuell im Stealth Mode an einer neuen Lösung, die genau hier ansetzt. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, von Anfang an Verantwortung zu übernehmen, eigene Ideen einzubringen und die Entwicklung aktiv mitzugestalten. Mehr über unsere Vision und das, woran wir arbeiten, erzählen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch. Dabei koordinierst du die dazugehörigen Prozesse und entwickelst unsere operativen Abläufe weiter. Was du mitbringst Idealerweise hast du deinen Bachelor oder Master abgeschlossen oder bist kurz vor dem Abschluss. Das ist aber keine zwingende Voraussetzung. Erste Praktika in Start-ups, Beratung oder Venture Capital. Erfahrung in Finance oder im Bereich erneuerbare Energien ist ein Plus. Du denkst unternehmerisch, erkennst Probleme und wartest nicht darauf, dass dir jemand die Lösung vorgibt. Du arbeitest täglich mit AI-Tools und setzt neue Tools direkt in deiner Arbeit ein. Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch Eher nicht passend, wenn ... du suchst ein klassisches Praktikum mit klar abgegrenzten Aufgaben und festen Routinen. du fühlst dich wohler mit klaren Vorgaben, statt eigene Lösungen zu entwickeln. du lieber auf Freigaben wartest, als selbst anzufangen. dich Rückschläge schnell aus der Bahn werfen. In einem frühen Unternehmen läuft vieles nicht beim ersten Mal, und Probleme landen oft ungefiltert auf dem Tisch. du den ganzen Tag nur an der großen Strategie feilen willst. Der Alltag in der Early Stage besteht zum Großteil aus Umsetzung, auch bei den Gründern. items.title: Account Executive, Mid-Market - DACH
items.snippet: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $2.1B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers. While many in the tech scene are scaling back, our DACH team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from € 10k to € 300k , selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded, this is the place. Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in Germany or London, UK, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis). You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world : Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting : The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline. You have innate curiosity in how businesses work : One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact. You are a life-long learner : Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work. You build genuine relationships with your customers : The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time. You want to be with the best : Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role you will: Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline. Get In Early: The DACH Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now. Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer. Minimum Requirements for the role: Winning DNA: Minimum 18 months+ closing experience in an outbound-heavy SaaS environment. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch. Over-achievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt Native German language speakers Advantageous: Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain. A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results. A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy. Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here . items.title: Strategic Finance Intern
items.snippet: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe's fastest-growing fusion company and the continent's best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world's first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world. You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals. Do your life's best work and enjoy the journey. Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT Building a fusion power plant is one of the most capital-intensive projects in Europe, and every major decision at Proxima rests on our financial models. Our Strategic Finance team owns the long-term investment model, the multi-year business plan, and the financial modelling behind our fundraising, government funding, and corporate development deals. As our Strategic Finance Intern, you will be a second pair of eyes on these models, making sure they are accurate, consistent, and speak from one source of truth. You will work directly with the Strategic Finance lead and partner with the wider finance team and department heads. WHAT YOU WILL DO Review and reconcile our models: Work through our long-term investment model and multi-year business plan, check formula integrity and cross-sheet consistency, and reconcile both against our budget. Find and resolve discrepancies: Keep a clear log of every mismatch you find, trace it to its cause, and work with the relevant teams to resolve it. Document how the models fit together: Write clear handover documentation on how our models connect and where each input comes from, so the next person can pick them up quickly. Build tools the team will use: Create dashboards and automations on top of the reconciled models to enable the business operations team and the rest of the business to quickly find answers to their finance questions. items.title: hbo-stage Analyseren kwaliteit bouwvergunningen BAG
items.snippet: hbo- afstudeerstage, vanaf februari 2027 Ben jij die nieuwsgierige en enthousiaste student die graag in data duikt en op zoek gaat naar opvallende patronen en verbanden? Krijg jij energie van het ontrafelen van complexe vraagstukken, het ontdekken van inzichten en het vertalen van data naar betekenisvolle resultaten? Dit is jouw uitdaging Het CBS ontvangt maandelijks van de 342 gemeenten in Nederland informatie over verleende bouwvergunningen. Gemeenten leveren deze gegevens aan via enquêtes en registreren de bouwvergunningen daarnaast in de Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG). Sinds 2025 publiceert het CBS de cijfers over bouwvergunningen op basis van de BAG. Er is echter een groot en toenemend verschil tussen de cijfers uit de BAG en de tellingen uit de enquêtes. Er is reeds onderzoek gedaan naar deze toenemende verschillen. Als stagiair ga je dit verder onderzoeken, door middel van een diepgaande analyse van de tijdigheid en kwaliteit van de registratie van gegevens in de BAG. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces om beter inzicht te krijgen in hoe de BAG zich verhoudt tot de werkelijkheid. Je onderzoekt onder andere: Hoe lang wachten gemeenten met registraties? Worden registraties doorlopend geregistreerd, of opgespaard en in korte tijd geregistreerd in de BAG? Verandert de kwaliteit en tijdigheid door de tijd heen? Om deze vragen te beantwoorden duik je in een grote database, waar je met behulp van SQL en R of Python trends gaat waarnemen, data visualiseert, en samenvattingen maakt. Daarnaast verzamel je informatie over het registratieproces, en hoe dit is geïmplementeerd bij gemeenten. Voor deze taak is al eerder onderzoek gedaan, en is er ook al meer informatie beschikbaar. Je verzamelt deze resultaten in een rapport met een overzicht van de huidige stand van zaken. Dit is jouw stageplek bij CBS Den Haag Ons team bestaat uit 24 enthousiaste collega’s, die met veel passie en plezier werken aan statistische informatie over vastgoed en de woningmarkt. We maken statistieken over (bouw)vergunningen, ontwikkeling van de woningvoorraad, (gemiddelde) WOZ-waardes, eigendomsverhoudingen, tijdelijke woningen, woningtransformaties en nog heel veel meer. We doen statistisch onderzoek op verzoek van organisaties in de publieke sector. En we beheren en verwerken data voor CBS-collega’s en werken samen met diverse organisaties, waaronder het Kadaster, de ministeries van BZK, VRO en EZK en Eurostat. We publiceren regelmatig over de dynamiek van de Nederlandse vastgoed- en woningmarkt. Onze nieuwsberichten halen regelmatig journaals, nieuwssites en voorpagina’s van landelijke dagbladen. En daar zijn we trots op! Dit breng jij mee Je volgt een hbo opleiding in de studierichting toegepaste wiskunde, data science of sociale wetenschappen. Je hebt affiniteit met de woningmarkt. Je hebt kennis en wellicht ervaring met R/rmarkdown en/of Python en SQL databases. Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en enthousiast om met data aan de slag te gaan. Je vindt het leuk om nieuwe dingen te ontdekken, neemt graag initiatief en denkt actief mee. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, maar zoekt ook graag de samenwerking op. Je deelt gemakkelijk je ideeën en bevindingen en staat open voor nieuwe inzichten en feedback. Omdat tijdens de stage alle communicatie – zowel mondeling als schriftelijk – in het Nederlands plaatsvindt, is een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal noodzakelijk. Dit kun je van ons verwachten Een fijne leeromgeving waarin je: samenwerkt met ervaren experts binnen hun vakgebied; gaat werken met grote databases (SQL); kennis opbouwt van de BAG en het registratieproces bij bronhouders; analyses samenvat in data visualisaties en overzichtelijke tabellen. Voor jouw inzet ontvang je een stagevergoeding van € 800,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week). Samen met je stagebegeleider stem je af hoe je hybride kunt werken, met flexibele werktijden en de optie om deels vanuit huis aan jouw stageopdracht te werken. Dit zijn onze voorwaarden Het betreft een stageopdracht en geen werkervaringsplek. Voordat je aan de stage begint verwachten we dat je vanuit de onderwijsinstelling een stagebegeleider hebt, waarmee de stage is afgestemd en concrete leerdoelen zijn afgesproken.
